title: Docs: Fix build command and typo in main config build
body:
## What I did
- Updated the `build.test` docs to reference the modern CLI command (`storybook build`) instead of `build-storybook`.
- Fixed a small typo in `test.disabledAddons` (“will be disabled”).

## Checklist for Contributors

### Testing

#### The changes in this PR are covered in the following automated tests:
- [ ] stories
- [ ] unit tests
- [ ] integration tests
- [ ] end-to-end tests

#### Manual testing
Manual test:
1. Open `docs/api/main-config/main-config-build.mdx`
2. Confirm the `test` section mentions running `storybook build` with `--test`
3. Confirm the `test.disabledAddons` description reads “will be disabled”

### Documentation
- [x] Add or update documentation reflecting your changes
- [ ] If you are deprecating/removing a feature, make sure to update MIGRATION.MD

## Checklist for Maintainers
(n/a)

### 🦋 Canary release
This PR does not have a canary release associated.

@pavan-sh, when you're able, can you revert this to the following? The rationale is that we use the script as much as possible to prevent issues with the build step. 
```suggestion
Configures Storybook's production builds for performance testing purposes by disabling certain features from the build. When running `build-storybook`, this feature is enabled by setting the `--test` [flag](../cli-options.mdx#build).
```
